text: {"findings":[{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Vague success metrics","detail":"\"Driver happiness\" and \"Faster handoffs\" are not canonical, defined metrics. They have no definition, formula, or data source, so the results can't be measured consistently.","evidence_quote":"Driver happiness: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Replace them with glossary-defined metrics, for example driver wait time at pickup, handoff duration, or a defined driver CSAT score."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"No baseline, numeric target, or timeframe","detail":"The success metrics say only \"improve\". They give no current baseline, no numeric target, and no timeframe for reaching it.","evidence_quote":"Faster handoffs: improve.","citations":[],"recommendation":"State the baseline, a numeric target, and a time window for each success metric, such as reducing median pickup wait from X to Y minutes within 8 weeks."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Incomplete guardrails for a driver-facing pickup change","detail":"The only guardrail is Cost Per Delivery, and it has no threshold. The change affects pickup timing and driver behavior, so it needs guardrails such as delivery time or on-time rate, order cancellation rate, and driver acceptance or offer decline rate. Without them, drivers could arrive late or decline orders.","evidence_quote":"Cost Per Delivery: must not increase.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails for on-time delivery, cancellations, and driver offer acceptance or decline rate, and give each a numeric tolerance."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"MDE is undefined and the randomization unit is unclear","detail":"The MDE is \"1 point\" with no metric or unit, and no baseline variance or sample size supports the power claim. The primary metric is never named, so the MDE can't be evaluated. Randomizing by store cluster also gives few units, with no clustering adjustment mentioned. Drivers who serve several clusters could see both arms.","evidence_quote":"Randomized by store cluster. Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 1 point, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Name the primary metric and express the MDE in its units. Show a power calculation that accounts for cluster-level variance. Confirm that drivers can't cross arms, or randomize at the driver level instead."}]}
